name: Kiliper Corporation
old_description: For over 25 years, Kiliper Corp, an Inovar company, has delivered high-quality packaging solutions with a focus on stretch sleeves, flexible packaging, and roll-fed label technologies. Known for quick turnaround times, flexible production, and dependable service, Kiliper helps brands move faster while maintaining consistent quality. From full-container decoration to high-speed labeling applications, Kiliper provides solutions designed to perform across a wide range of industries including food & beverage, household products, industrial, and more.
about:
Based in Ames, Iowa, Kiliper Corporation has been delivering packaging solutions for more than 25 years. The company operates as a family-owned business and is part of the Inovar Packaging Group, a national packaging partner that provides expanded resources and a broader manufacturing network.

Kiliper specializes in stretch sleeve labeling, roll-fed label production, and flexible packaging, supported by advanced flexographic printing capabilities. The company offers material expertise and helps customers navigate packaging decisions, optimize materials, and deliver solutions aligned with brand and operational needs. Production is characterized by quick turnaround times and adaptable capabilities that support a wide range of program scales.

The company serves industries including food and beverage, household products, industrial, pet care, and agriculture. Its customers are brands seeking efficient, cost-effective packaging solutions that perform across applications such as full-container decoration and high-speed labeling.

Kiliper emphasizes a hands-on, service-driven approach built on long-term relationships, deep knowledge of stretch sleeve and roll-fed label applications, and reliable processes that ensure consistent quality. The partnership with Inovar adds scalable support while maintaining the responsiveness and personalized service the company is known for.
